# Canonical Realty

> Canonical Realty is a Nairobi-based property valuation, property management, and estate agency firm serving clients across Kenya. Work is carried out under the regulatory frameworks of the Valuers Registration Board (VRB), the Institution of Surveyors of Kenya (ISK), and the Estate Agents Registration Board (EARB), with valuations aligned to IFRS Red Book standards.

Key facts:
- Website: https://canonicalrealty.com
- Office: Agip House, 6th Floor, Flat 6, Office 4, Nairobi, Kenya
- Phone / WhatsApp: +254 712 244 494
- Email: info@canonicalrealty.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EAT

## Services
- [Valuation Services](https://canonicalrealty.com/services/valuation): Decision-grade property valuations for mortgage financing, audit, litigation, tax, and acquisition, signed off by VRB-registered valuers.
- [Property Management](https://canonicalrealty.com/services/property-management): Tech-enabled rental management with transparent ledgers, proactive maintenance, and dependable monthly disbursements for landlords.
- [Estate Agency](https://canonicalrealty.com/services/estate-agency): Sales and lettings across residential, commercial, and land, plus lease advisory, with valuation-informed pricing.

## Credentials
- Regulated by the Valuers Registration Board (VRB) of Kenya
- Corporate membership of the Institution of Surveyors of Kenya (ISK)
- Registered with the Estate Agents Registration Board (EARB)
- Valuation reporting aligned to IFRS Red Book standards
